title: What to know when building your home office | What YouTubers don't tell you
description:
Due to COVID-19, many companies are mandating employees work from home (WFH) for the remainder of 2020 so you might be thinking about upgrading your home office. We did hours of YouTube research to find the best "desk" setup, built it ourselves and learned a LOT.

Our "desk" is two IKEA Alex Drawers and an IKEA Karlby countertop. This setup is recommended by popular channels like randomfrankp & Matthew Encina (this video is not sponsored by IKEA)

From our experience, small details became very big problems- like your room layout (outlets, internet, etc.) and simply carrying everything into your car/home. We had a lot of headaches and wanted to call out some of these things so you won't run into the same problems.
